name: AKU to hold the 11th National Health Sciences Research Symposium

content.title: AKU to hold the 11th National Health Sciences Research Symposium
content.summary: Aga Khan University (AKU) is holding its 11nth National Health Sciences Research Symposium on "Understanding and Managing Pain - Multidisciplinary Approaches" from September 6 to 7.

media.alt: AKU to hold the 11th National Health Sciences Research Symposium

content.text: Aga Khan University (AKU) is holding its 11nth National Health Sciences Research Symposium on "Understanding and Managing Pain - Multidisciplinary Approaches" from September 6 to 7. This is a multidisciplinary Symposium that will provide a wonderful opportunity for eminent professional and researchers in pain management to present their ideas and work, share experiences, attempt to identify key problem in the area of pain and the strategies to address relevant issues in Pakistan. Invited speakers and delegates of 13 different countries including India, Bangladesh, Sri-Lanka, Malaysia, UAE, Qatar, Saudi-Arabia, UK, USA, Iran, Nairobi, Masqat, and Australia are expected to attend symposium.

Control of pain has been a relatively neglected area across the world, particularly in developing countries. The Symposium will raise awareness about importance of pain management services and stimulate thinking to improve education and research on relevant topics of pain.

The National Health Sciences Research Symposium (NHSRS) is an annual event by AKU on a topic relevant to Pakistan and the region. The recent past symposia have focused on reproductive health, mental health and health sciences education. The University appreciates that the endemic problems of a region beset with financial difficulties and low development indicators can be addressed only through relevant research focusing on producing low cost, accessible and innovative solutions.
